items.question: What is this platform?
items.answer: Althair AI is an AI front office in development. It will bring together customer inquiries, assistant replies and permitted actions, human handoff, and CRM outcome tracking.

items.question: Which businesses is it for?
items.answer: It is designed for salons, clinics, stores, education centers, auto repair shops, real-estate agencies, hotels, and other service businesses.

items.question: Which channels will it support?
items.answer: Instagram, Telegram, WhatsApp, Gmail, SMS, web chat, and phone scenarios are planned. Channel integrations will roll out in stages.

items.question: Can AI create leads and bookings?
items.answer: That is planned when the company permits the action and the connected integration supports it. Automation boundaries will be configured separately for each workflow.

items.question: Can a team member take over a conversation?
items.answer: Yes. A team member will be able to continue the conversation with its history and the context already collected.

items.question: How does AI get company information?
items.answer: The team will add verified information such as services, prices, hours, rules, and documents to the workspace. The assistant will use it as working context and will not be able to change rules or permissions on its own.

items.question: Is each company’s data kept separate?
items.answer: A separate workspace is planned for each company, so its data and context do not mix with those of other teams.

items.question: What happens when AI is not confident in an answer?
items.answer: It will ask a clarifying question or hand the conversation to a team member, according to the company’s rules.

items.question: Is the product available now?
items.answer: There is no public launch yet. We are accepting applications for a future early-access cohort.
